description: MCP tool definition for the Phase allocator — turn human intent into a bounded Phase ISA allocation plan (route/tools/budget) for an LLM agent to execute. The SLM coordinates; the calling LLM does the work.

tools.name: phase_allocate
tools.description: Turn human intent into a bounded Phase allocation plan. Calls the SLM (or a heuristic fallback) to decide the agent route, granted tools, and budget for a task in a repo. Returns a JSON plan plus the human-readable Phase ISA. Use this before executing a task so you work within the right budget and tool set. Never invents project truth; clamps every decision to the caller's ceiling.

task.description: Human intent / objective to allocate for (e.g. 'fix the failing auth tests').

repo.description: Absolute path to the repository/git root to coordinate. Defaults to the current working directory.

policy.description: 'model' calls the configured SLM endpoint; 'heuristic' is a deterministic offline fallback. Default model.

model.description: SLM model id, e.g. qwen2.5:0.5b. Default reads PHASE_SLM_MODEL.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. Default reads PHASE_SLM_BASE_URL or http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.
